text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're halfway through summer camp, and Winning Ticket is devoting herself to training every single day.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! I gotta work hard so I can get everyone fired up at my next race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The plan for today is to run together with another racer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Guwaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Wow, they sure can run!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Hey, look—that's Winning Ticket! Keep up the great work, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Ticket has gathered more spectators than one would expect to see at practice.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the support, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! I didn't think we'd get this much attention all the way out here at camp!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I wonder if these people watched the Derby and had a blast cheering us on there too…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Just imagining it gets me really fired up! I'm burning hot!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I might've reached my dream of racing in the Derby, but I'm not stopping there!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've gotta run more and more races that inspire people!
choice_data_list: Then let's keep practicing with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Our Twinkle Series is just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go hard today and do some super tough drills!
choice_data_list: Okay, then how about a hundred beach sprints?
Okay, then how about long-distance swimming?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoooaa! A hundred beach sprints? That's craaaaazy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But when you say it with that much passion, I can tell you're not kidding! I can't back down from this!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: YEAAAAAH! Let's gooooo! GO, ME!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pumping herself up, Winning Ticket sets off toward the beach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Ticket's summer camp continues at full blast.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Long-distance swimming?! That sounds like… SUPER scary!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But you've got a point—if I can pull it off, I feel like I won't be turning over just one new leaf—it'll be a whole tree!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All RIIIGHT! I'm gonna swim full steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: This'll take real guts !

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Ticket's summer camp continues at full blast.
